title: Binance Evolves Capital Connect: A Portfolio Marketplace for Institutional Investors and Trading Teams
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance has upgraded Capital Connect, a marketplace that links professional trading teams with institutional investors, built natively on  Binance Portfolio Accounts  infrastructure. What Is Capital Connect? Capital Connect gives institutional investors structured access to professional crypto strategies, and gives trading teams a platform to raise and manage capital — all within Binance's existing exchange, custody, and compliance infrastructure. How It Works Capital remains held in custody within Binance at all times. Trading Teams control execution, while Investors retain ownership of their assets.  All participants, Investors and Trading Teams alike, are subject to mandatory Know Your Business (KYB) verification.  Performance data is disclosed directly by Binance; Trading Teams cannot self-report or edit historical records. For Investors Investors can search, filter, and compare strategies by: Strategy type (Market Neutral, Directional, Statistical Arbitrage and more) Performance (30-day return, return since inception, NAV per allocation) Risk metrics (Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown) Terms (minimum investment, currency, fees, lock-up period, settlement window) Each portfolio strategy includes cumulative return curve and NAV trendline. Portfolio names are disclosed after subscription. To subscribe, select a portfolio and enter your investment amount, then click  "Subscribe”  to submit your request. Upon approval by the Trading Team, capital transfers to the Portfolio Account and allocations appear after daily settlement. Eligibility: Capital Connect is free for Investors to access. Access is open to KYB-verified entities and subject to jurisdiction, meeting one of the following financial qualification criteria: VIP 3 status or above Total assets on Binance ≥ 1,000,000 USD External asset proof of equivalent value submitted for review For Trading Teams To onboard Capital Connect successfully, Trading Teams must: Hold a valid Asset Management or Portfolio Management licence (or recognised exemption) issued by a regulated authority in their jurisdiction; Complete KYB verification; and Have a minimum of 30 days of active  Portfolio Account  trading history. Trading Teams that are already using Portfolio Accounts may apply after licence verification, with no new onboarding required. New Trading Teams are required to follow the standard Portfolio Account onboarding process. Commission & Fees Binance charges 0% commission on Capital Connect for Trading Teams during the initial launch period. Any fee changes will be announced in advance.  How to Get Started Investors can access the  Capital Connect marketplace  directly on Binance, those who are KYB-verified, VIP 3 and above can qualify.  If you are not part of Binance VIP yet, you can   join now  to get access to a range of  VIP-only benefits , including lower fees, higher limits, priority support, and more.  Trading Teams must complete KYB onboarding, configure their Portfolio Account, and maintain a 30-day active trading history before applying to be listed on Capital Connect. For detailed onboarding instructions, eligible entities may contact their dedicated Account Manager.
